description: I1 probe for prop:hecke-branching-trace-decomposition.  Verifies the closed-form (I = 𝟙) branching identity χ^λ(β_1 · β_2) = Σ_(μ,ν) c^λ_{μ,ν} χ_μ(β_1) χ_ν(β_2) for β_1 = β_2 = β_{4_1} on disjoint strand groups, λ ∈ {(6), (5,1), (4,2), (3,3), (1^6)} ⊢ 6 (n_1 = n_2 = 3).  LHS computed directly via canonical H_6 Hoefsmit-seminormal matrices (mpmath, 50 dps); RHS computed from H_3 single-component characters via Wenzl-1988 LR coefficients.  Equality witnesses Wenzl 1988 Thm 3.4 + Hoefsmit 1974 matrix-element formulas on a concrete instance, independent of the operator-extraction path in `sublemma_2_1_A_operator_extract.py`.

methodology.left_hand_side: Trace of ρ_λ(β_Bor_2) ∈ End(V_λ) where β_Bor_2 = σ_1 σ_2⁻¹ σ_1 σ_2⁻¹ · σ_4 σ_5⁻¹ σ_4 σ_5⁻¹ is the disjoint product of two figure-eights in B_6.  ρ_λ is the canonical H_6 Hoefsmit-seminormal rep (satisfies Hecke quadratic AND braid relation; verified to ~1e-50 in PR #818 follow-up).
methodology.right_hand_side: Σ_{μ,ν ⊢ 3} c^λ_{μ,ν} · χ_μ(β_{4_1}) · χ_ν(β_{4_1}), where c^λ_{μ,ν} are Littlewood-Richardson coefficients (table inlined in source, verified by dimension check Σ c^λ_{μν} dim_μ dim_ν = dim_λ).  Single-component characters χ_μ(β_{4_1}) computed via canonical H_3 Hoefsmit.
